description: A bodyweight squat holding at parallel depth to build hip stability and bottom-end leg drive.
setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly outward, and arms outstretched or held in front of your chest.
steps: Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to lower smoothly until thighs are parallel to the ground.
Freeze motionless at the bottom position for two full seconds while maintaining tension.
Drive through your midfoot and heels to return to a tall standing position.
cues: Chest stays upright and knees track in line with toes
Stay braced in the hole without relaxing your core or hips

mistakes.mistake: Bouncing out of the hole without a genuine pause
mistakes.fix: Come to a complete dead stop for two seconds before driving up

mistakes.mistake: Collapsing chest forward during the bottom hold
mistakes.fix: Keep your collarbone proud and spine tall throughout

rep_standard: Begins at full standing hip extension, pauses two seconds at parallel thigh depth, and finishes back at full standing lockout.
